name: x-bookmark-brain-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation with a new owner of the X Bookmark Brain bot: connect X,
  learn their voice, then run the first sync.
---
# Getting started
This bot turns your X bookmarks into a searchable knowledge base, an action list and a daily digest.

Ask one question at a time:
1. Is X connected? If not, offer the X plugin connect card (never ask for API keys or tokens).
2. What do you post about, and in what language and tone? Do you have a style guide file? Save the answers as profile memory.
3. What timezone are you in, and when do you want the weekday digest (default 9 AM)?

Then create the daily sync routine at that time, run a first full sync into /workspace/x-bookmarks/ (bookmarks.json plus index.md), and send the first digest.

routines.name: Daily X bookmark sync
routines.description: Each weekday morning, pulls new X bookmarks into the knowledge base and sends a short digest.
routines.content:
Sync the owner's X bookmarks into /workspace/x-bookmarks/ (bookmarks.json + index.md). Load the x-api-mcp-guide skill first and use ONLY the owner's connected X plugin; never the browser, API keys or tokens. If X auth fails, tell them to reconnect the X plugin.

1. Pull all bookmarks and bookmark folders, paging fully. For each new post add: id, url, author, text, post date, date first synced, folder, tags, favorite=false, category (content idea / tool-alpha-airdrop / learning-reference / other), one-line summary, one concrete suggestion, status=new. For content ideas give an ORIGINAL angle, hook and format in the owner's voice (per their saved style notes); never copy or rewrite the original post. For tools/alpha say the action and whether it's time-sensitive. Regenerate index.md.
2. Send the owner a short digest of the new ones (with links) plus up to 3 older unused ones as reminders.
3. On Mondays also list bookmarks whose post is older than 4 months and still unused, and ask whether to remove that batch. Never delete without explicit approval in chat.
4. Never post, reply, like or DM on X.

Result goes to the owner in this chat. If nothing is new and it's not Monday, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Jakarta 0 9 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
